description: This Java class, ContentManagementWorker, provides utility methods for managing content entities within the OFBIZ framework. It includes functions for handling recently viewed items, permission checks, publish point retrieval, static content association, and content statistics updates.

classes.name: ContentManagementWorker
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for content management tasks such as cache handling, permission checking, publish point retrieval, content statistics updates, and other content entity operations within the OFBIZ framework.

methods.name: mruAdd
methods.description: Adds an entity to the 'most recently used' list stored in the session, useful for tracking recently viewed content entities.

methods.name: mruAddByEntityName
methods.description: Stores the primary key signature of a content entity into the LIFO cache for the given entity name, updating its MRU list.

methods.name: mostRecentlyViewedIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the MRU cache entries for a specified entity name, allowing retrieval of recently viewed entities.

methods.name: buildPKSig
methods.description: Constructs a string signature from primary key fields of a GenericEntity or GenericPK, optionally appending a suffix.

methods.name: setCurrentEntityMap
methods.description: Stores a given entity in the session's current entity map, keyed by entity name.

methods.name: getFromSomewhere
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value from a hierarchy of sources: param map, request attribute, or context map.

methods.name: getCurrentValue
methods.description: Loads the current entity's primary key and value into the request scope based on request parameters or cached PKs.

methods.name: getCurrentValueWithCachedPK
methods.description: Resolves the current primary key from passed parameters and cached PK, querying the database for the current entity value.

methods.name: getPermittedPublishPoints
methods.description: Returns a list of publish points that the current user has permission to access for a specified action and operations.

methods.name: getAllPublishPoints
methods.description: Retrieves all publish points (ContentAssoc entities) related to a parent publish point.

methods.name: getPublishPointMap
methods.description: Creates a map from contentId to WebSitePublishPoint entity for a given list or single ID.

methods.name: getAllPublishPointMap
methods.description: Recursively builds a map of all publish points starting from a parent publish point ID.

methods.name: getStaticValues
methods.description: Fetches static content values associated with a parent placeholder, including its content associations with publish points.

methods.name: getWebSitePublishPoint
methods.description: Fetches the WebSitePublishPoint entity for a given content ID, respecting cache unless ignored.

methods.name: overrideWebSitePublishPoint
methods.description: Overrides a WebSitePublishPoint with its parent’s or related entity if applicable.

methods.name: getParentWebSitePublishPointValue
methods.description: Gets the parent WebSitePublishPoint content entity for a given content ID.

methods.name: getParentWebSitePublishPointId
methods.description: Retrieves the parent WebSitePublishPoint’s content ID via ContentAssoc relation.

methods.name: getStaticValue
methods.description: Placeholder for static value retrieval with caching; implementation incomplete.

methods.name: getPublishedLinks
methods.description: Retrieves publish link relationships for a target content ID, constructing a list of link details with date info.

methods.name: getAuthorContent
methods.description: Fetches author content linked to a given content ID via ContentAssoc of type 'AUTHOR'.

methods.name: getPermittedDepartmentPoints
methods.description: Returns department content points the user is permitted to access.

methods.name: getAllDepartmentContent
methods.description: Retrieves department content entities linked via ContentAssoc of type 'DEPARTMENT'.

methods.name: getUserName
methods.description: Resolves the full name of a user based on userLoginId.

methods.name: updateStatsTopDown
methods.description: Recursively updates child content counts (branch and leaf counts) for a content entity and its descendants.

methods.name: updateStatsBottomUp
methods.description: Updates the counts of leaf and branch nodes upward in the content hierarchy, starting from a given content ID.
